title: Rooms
subtitle: Rooms, prices, capacity and status. One row is one physical room.

form.name: Room name
form.locationHint: Area, then the province or city after the last comma. The part after the last comma is the home page "destination".
form.nameTypeRequired: Please enter the room name and type.
form.priceInvalid: The price must be greater than 0.
form.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a whole number greater than 0.
form.amenitiesHint: One per line, up to 30. Shown on the room page; leave empty to hide the Amenities section.
form.typeNewHint: Name of the new room type. If it matches one already in use (ignoring case and spaces), that one is used.
form.typeExists: “{{type}}” already exists: the room goes into that type.

gallery.title: More photos
gallery.afterSave: Save the room first, then open it again to add more photos.

confirm.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone. A room with bookings cannot be deleted; set it to "Maintenance" instead.
